title: Twenty Individuals Can Outvote Natural Selection
summary: Run a small population beside a large one under identical selection. Below a threshold set by 4Ns, sampling noise decides which allele survives, and the exact Markov chain says precisely where that threshold sits.

sources.title: Kimura, On the probability of fixation of mutant genes in a population, Genetics 47 (1962) 713-719
Ewens, Mathematical Population Genetics I, 2nd edition, chapters 2 and 5
Gillespie, Population Genetics: A Concise Guide, 2nd edition, chapter 2
